notes: Bumped after the v0.105.1..v0.107.0 sweep (the v0.106.0 tag never got a published GitHub Release, so the self-hoster-visible delta spanned both tags). CORRECTION to the previous sweep: features/scripts.mdx claimed secret tenant variables are delivered to scripts as redacted environment variables -- that is PR #3820, still open. At v0.107.0 secrets can be STORED but not USED: script save is rejected on a {{var.x}} secret reference and dispatch fails the device; rewrote the Secret variables section to say so. deploy/binaries.mdx + environment.mdx + upgrades.mdx: boot-time binary sync is now pinned to the server's own release (#3742/#3808) and deliberately does NOT fall back to /releases/latest -- a pinned-but-unpublished tag registers zero agent binaries; also fixed the BINARY_VERSION row and corrected TURN_HOST/TURN_SECRET from 'Yes (prod)' to 'only with the turn profile'. environment.mdx: added PENDING_ACCOUNT_MEETING_URL/LABEL (#3771), previously undocumented. code-signing.mdx + agents/installation.mdx: Viewer/Helper moved to an SSL.com OV cert (SmartScreen reputation resets) and the public Windows agent family ships unsigned by design. features/ai-for-office.mdx: new 'Working Tickets from Outlook (Technicians)' section (#3596) -- the page previously asserted AI for Office is 'not a tool for your technicians', which was wrong for Outlook. features/mobile.mdx: three real tabs are Home/Systems/Tickets (Navigation + UI Framework sections were stale), new Tickets section, browsable device list with its one-page caveat, app lock now survives process death, self-hosted BREEZE_ASSOCIATED_DOMAINS prebuild step. Billing: online-payments.mdx 'Sending a Payment Link' was factually wrong (no such button; the link is now a durable customer link, 12mo / due+180d, resettable) -- rewritten; invoices.mdx gained currency provenance, the send composer + re-send, and minor-unit payment rounding; quotes.mdx gained declined-quote handling, auto-email on acceptance, and a currency note; contracts/portal/regional-settings/reference-api picked up currency + public-link rows. monitoring/stack.mdx: http_requests_total / http_request_duration_seconds / agent_heartbeat_total emitted nothing before v0.107.0 (#3763). features/snmp.mdx: binary OCTET STRINGs now stored as hex instead of failing the whole poll batch (#3765). Deliberately NOT documented: the release trust-allowlist CI guard (#3504/#3761 -- maintainer-only, no runtime change); mobile CSRF/partial-state plumbing; vulnerability bulk-action id batching; the Outlook pane's dead 'Open ticket' affordance and non-functional contact picker (shipped but inert).
